name: Avatar / Team Member
description: Team Member product scenario for the Avatar component.

controls.name: src
controls.description: Image URL; the fallback stands in while it is missing, pending or broken.

controls.name: name
controls.description: The person's full name: the accessible name, and the initials when `fallback` is absent.

controls.name: fallback
controls.description: Text or rich content shown instead of initials while the image is unavailable.

controls.name: fallbackDelay
controls.description: Milliseconds a pending image waits before the fallback shows; a missing or broken image shows it at once.
